description: Change a plugin's name, description and/or slug (at least one); omitted fields keep their value. `target` is a plugin name, or an id with `byId: true`, never a slug. A changed slug renames the plugin package and its commands: the result then has a warning naming the old and the new slug. It does not regenerate the install, even for the installed plugin: the local install follows at the next `athenode init` or regeneration. A `slug` is refused, writing nothing, with code `plugin_slug_conflict` (409: another plugin of the project has it), `plugin_slug_forbidden` (a reserved slug), `plugin_slug_locked` (the slug of this plugin cannot be changed) or `plugin_slug_invalid` (not a valid slug).

byId.description: The given value is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --by-id <id>).

description.description: The plugin's new description, at most 25000 characters.

name.description: The plugin's new name, at most 200 characters.

slug.description: The plugin's new slug (CLI: --slug); the current one is kept if omitted. Unique in the project; it is the name of the plugin package and the prefix of its commands.

target.description: Name (or, with byId, id) of the plugin to update.

name: plugins_update
title: Update plugin
